title: Oversized, Thick-and-Thin Bath Towel With Interesting Grid Pattern
text:
Oversized, Thick-and-Thin Bath Towel With Interesting Grid Pattern. This OTTOMANSON PURE COTTON COLLECTION LUXURY BATH TOWEL (27" L x 55" W; Lavender) is a pleasing shade of lavender; is a very big, oversized bath towel; and has an interesting grid pattern formed by raised terry cloth loops on a plain woven cotton base fabric.

However, it is a very thin towel, made of “Turkish cotton dobby terry cloth”, that doesn’t have a luxury feel at all. It seems very expensive (about $18 on Amazon) for what it is. I much prefer thick bath towels with terry loops all over—towels that resemble the pile on a thick carpet (see, e.g., [[ASIN:B00GQP0Z9E Utopia Bath Towel Set]]).
